source: GitHub (euan-forrester/save-file-converter issue #297, 'Add ability to convert MiSTer N64 files'); the same five files are the converter's test data (frontend/tests/data/save-formats/mister/n64)
author: Unknown MiSTer user; attached as 'Example files: MiSTer N64 saves.zip' by euan-forrester (save-file-converter's author) on 2024-04-24. The zip's macOS quarantine records say he downloaded them with Firefox on 2024-04-23.
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue; the repository is GPL-3.0)
what_it_is: Donkey Kong 64, 16 Kbit EEPROM. 2048 bytes, file dated 2024-02-04 21:11. Not booted here.
note: Attributed to the MiSTer N64 core by the issue ('The new core has all the different possible file types split up') and by the names: '<ROM stem>.eep/.sra/.fla' and '<ROM stem>_1.cpk' are what MiSTer's Main (support/n64/n64.cpp) names N64 saves, and '_N.cpk' is MiSTer's alone. The file dates (Dec 2023 - Feb 2024) are after Main's December 2023 change that split the old single .sav into one file per chip and pak. Main of that time created new save files filled with 0x00 (0xFF since Main commit bc49794, 2026-01-13). 2048 bytes, the chip's size; one 0xFF byte in the whole file, the rest data or 0x00.
